description: Interface definition for the ASH Pattern Engine
purpose: Detects cosmic patterns from ASH state analysis and provides generation seeds to all other engines

inputs.name: cosmic_state
inputs.description: Current state of the cosmos from the Cosmology Engine

inputs.name: player_state
inputs.description: Current player state for pattern personalization

methods.name: detect_patterns
methods.description: Analyze current ASH state and detect active cosmic patterns

methods.name: get_pattern_by_id
methods.description: Retrieve a specific pattern by its ID

methods.name: evaluate_pattern_strength
methods.description: Calculate the strength of a pattern given current cosmic conditions

invariants: All patterns must derive from ASH cosmological state analysis
No independent random generation of meaningful content
Pattern strength is always between 0 and 1
All expansion engines must read from detected patterns
